```{python}
import numpy as np

import transpose_invariance as tpi

import skimage as ski
import skimage.segmentation as ss
```

```{python}
imgs = tpi.get_3d_images()
```

```{python}
imgs = [tpi.without_ties(img) for img in imgs]
img = imgs[0]
```

```{python}
# Marker generation code
from scipy import ndimage as ndi

def get_markers(image, connectivity=1, mask=None):
    if mask is None:
        # Use a complete `True` mask if none is provided
        mask = np.ones(image.shape, bool)
    markers_bool = ski.morphology.local_minima(image, connectivity=connectivity) * mask
    footprint = ndi.generate_binary_structure(markers_bool.ndim, connectivity)
    return ndi.label(markers_bool, structure=footprint)[0]
```

```{python}
func = lambda img : ss.watershed(img, get_markers(img))
ws_orig = func(img)
```

```{python}
ws_rolled = tpi.rolled_proc(img, (2, 1, 0), func)
tpi.assert_labels_equivalent(ws_rolled, ws_orig)
```

```{python}
# All images are transpose invariant
tpi.assert_all_orders(imgs, func)
```
